name: rule-control-another-slug-as-asked
why: Control: a rule made as asked for one branch does not cover another run's branch: code finds the push outside it.

statements: allow read on anything in repository $primary.repo
allow push on branch "discobox/26-10-12-330" in repository $primary.repo
allow create, update on pull request in repository $primary.repo when "its head is discobox/26-10-12-330 and its base is main"
allow create on comment within pull request in repository $primary.repo
allow rerun on workflow run in repository $primary.repo when "it failed"
deny push on branch "main" in repository $primary.repo
deny force-push, delete on branch in anywhere
deny merge, close on pull request in anywhere
deny delete on comment in anywhere
deny cancel, delete on workflow run in anywhere
deny dispatch on workflow in anywhere
deny read on secret in anywhere

definitions.branch: a git branch in a repository
definitions.cancel: stop a run that is in progress
definitions.close: close a pull request or issue without merging it
definitions.comment: a comment or review reply on a pull request or issue
definitions.dispatch: start a workflow run by hand
definitions.force-push: move a branch with --force and no lease
definitions.merge: merge a pull request into its base
definitions.push: add commits to a branch, or move it with --force-with-lease
definitions.secret: an Actions, Dependabot or environment secret
